title: Billing Refund Eligibility and Settlement
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Billing reviews refund eligibility against the original order total and payment status. A simulation may recommend a full or partial refund but never sends money.
If a duplicate charge is reported, compare transaction references and timestamps before classifying the second charge. Escalate conflicting records for billing review.
When a refund is approved, record its amount, currency, original payment reference, and estimated settlement window. Never redirect a refund to a different payment method.
A refund request outside the published window requires a documented exception review. Missing transaction evidence is a reason to request evidence, not to assume a charge occurred.
